Local first

Franklin Assistant is part of Franklin Navigator and routes you through Franklin-specific resident, civic, professional and community resources.

  • Whole-situation routing
  • Official-source handoffs
  • No account required for public help
Ask and continue

Get connected next steps without starting over later.

Describe a short, non-sensitive Franklin goal. Franklin Assistant can connect up to three relevant starting points and save only those matched topics and links to My Franklin on this device.

Open saved next steps

Keep private medical, legal, financial and account details out of the question. Saved plans contain matched topics and links only—not your words.

Real situations can cross categories.

You do not need to decide whether your problem is “legal,” “health,” “home,” “auto” or “government” before asking. Start with what happened and what you need to accomplish.

I need help after a car problem and I am worried about insurance.My parent needs transportation and help staying independent.I am dealing with a home problem and do not know which office handles it.I run a Franklin business and want to participate more locally.

Privacy and safety

  • Avoid passwords, account numbers and private medical or legal documents.
  • For emergencies, use the appropriate emergency service rather than Franklin Assistant.
  • Changing eligibility, legal, health and government details should be confirmed at the linked original source.
